text:
[LSCO.3.2.1] A DS program is a set of declarations ([LGRA.3.1]). Rules are
the part that acts: a rule fires on the facts it matches, and acts through typed
actions ([LSCO.2.7.1]). An expression is strongly typed and side-effect-free,
and every call in one resolves to a built-in or a `unit formula`'s function
([LGRA.9.8.11]).
